subject: MAP template + initial MAP gdoc — workshop prep & close timeline
messages:
From: Ari Kahn <ari.kahn@tessera.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@tessera.ai
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAPs + evaluation approach — can you share a template and a sample timeline?

Hi Jordan,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — team was impressed with the latency numbers. Procurement asked me to get a concrete mutual action plan (MAP) and a rough close timeline so they can align budgets and legal. Two things we need: a MAP template we can adapt, and an initial draft MAP (gdoc or slides) we can review in a short workshop.

Can you share your standard MAP template and a 30–60 day evaluation timeline by EOD next week? Also please include a short checklist of technical acceptance criteria (SLOs, data retention, audit log access) so our security folks have something to look at.

I'll loop procurement on the follow-up. Thanks —

— Ari
Ari Kahn
Director, Integrations
Tessera Health

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Ari Kahn <ari.kahn@tessera.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAPs + evaluation approach — can you share a template and a sample timeline?

Hi Ari —

Great to hear the demo landed well. Attaching our MAP template (gdoc link below and an attached stub) and an initial 45-day evaluation timeline that tends to work for teams doing both technical validation and stakeholder alignment. Highlights up front:

- Workshop: 60–90 minute MAP co-creation session (week 0) to align stakeholders and pick acceptance tests.
- Tech validation: Week 1–3 (integration, small-scale inference, latency/cost checks).
- Acceptance & procurement: Week 4–6 (SLA review, security questionnaire, PO/procurement).

Attachments: tessera_map_template_v1.gdoc (live), initial-map-slides.pptx (30/60/90 view).

Quick ask: could you confirm who from security and from product will join the workshop so we can tailor the acceptance criteria section? If procurement is ready, we can include a short procurement checklist in the MAP and add a DocuSign link later.

Links:
- MAP template (editable): https://docs.google.com/document/d/1AbCdEFgTesseraMap
- Starter slides: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1SlideDeckTessera

I'll hand this to Marissa and Ben to draft the first MAP doc for your review.

Thanks,

Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: tessera_map_template_v1.gdoc (Google Doc link)]
[Attachment: initial-map-slides.pptx (pptx, 2.4MB)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Ari Kahn <ari.kahn@tessera.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Oct 2026 13:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAPs + evaluation approach — draft MAP gdoc (first pass)

Hi Ari —

I pulled together a first-pass MAP gdoc and a short slide deck that maps to the 45-day timeline Jordan outlined. Key pieces included in the gdoc:

1) Objectives & success metrics (business + technical)
2) Week-by-week milestones (integration, perf checks, user validation, procurement)
3) Acceptance criteria matrix (latency p50/p95 targets, max cost per 1k tokens, allowed data retention window)
4) Roles & owners (Redwood: Jordan/Marissa/Ben; Tessera: Ari + security + infra)

Notes / open items:
- I left the acceptance criteria placeholders — need Tessera's security and infra owners to confirm required p95 targets and data retention constraints.
- Suggested workshop agenda is included (see slide 3 in the attached pptx).

Next steps I propose:
- Quick 30-minute sync early next week to co-edit the gdoc and finalize owners.
- Workshop (60–90m) later that same week to align acceptance criteria and close timeline.

Ari: can you suggest two slots on Tue/Wed next week that work for you and the security lead?

Thanks — I attached the draft slides as promised.

Marissa Cole
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: initial-map-slides.pptx (pptx, 2.4MB)]

From: Ari Kahn <ari.kahn@tessera.ai>

Thanks Marissa — this looks like exactly what we need.

Procurement looped me in and asked for two things before the workshop: a short checklist of required evidence (SOC2 report, high-level network diagram, retention policy) and a simple cost estimate for a 30-day pilot (expected 50k tokens/day). Procurement suggested a brief call to go over procurement timeline — I'll propose Tue 11/3 9:30am PT and Wed 11/4 2:00pm PT. Which works for you?

Security will be represented by Lina Park (lina.park@tessera.ai) — she should join the co-edit.

If you can add a short "procurement checklist" section to the gdoc prior to the workshop, that will help speed approvals. Otherwise we can add it live.

Appreciate the fast turn — Ari

Ari Kahn
Director, Integrations
Tessera Health
